test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

The new chairman of the company __announced attracted bonus for the employees__ on the occasion of the new year.

options.text: announced an attractive bonus for the employees
announcing attracted bonus for the employees
announced attracting bonus for the employees

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase **"announced attracted bonus" is incorrect.**
 
• The correct form should be **"announced an attractive bonus,"** using the correct adjective** "attractive"** instead of the verb form** "attracted."**
 
• When describing **a noun, we use adjectives rather than verbs.**
 
• Examples:
 
 
• She wore an **elegant** dress to the party.
 
 
• They enjoyed an** exciting **movie last night.​
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct statement is "*The new chairman of the company announced an attractive bonus for the employees on the occasion of the new year."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Other options are incorrect or unnecessary:

 
• "No improvement required" is incorrect because there is an error.
 
• "Announcing attracted bonus for the employees" and "announced attracting bonus for the employees" are both grammatically incorrect and do not make sense contextually.
